extracted.name: Sweet jaggery crepes
extracted.description: Start of every year should be sweet as it shows the way, this recipe better called as patishapta in bengal is made onset of winter every year and is a personal favorite too #madethis
instruction_lines: Mix the flour with milk and make a fine paste.
Put the jaggery in heated pan as it liquifies pour the coconut flakes and blend well
Take batches out of the wet paste and pour it in the pan like pancakes and put a little amount of coconut/jaggery mix and wrap it around.
